name: PR/SET domain 10
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PRDM10 encodes PR domain zinc finger protein 10. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
